method: 52-record systematic spot review of names, descriptions and source URLs against all 399 supplied taxonomy nodes. Predictions were hidden in this review view; some original README examples were previously visible. Not a statistically random accuracy estimate. No live source re-fetch. Remaining records receive structural checks only.

records.rationale: Structural carbon-fibre fabric has no explicit FRP reinforcement leaf; surface reinforcement is not necessarily equivalent.
Anchoring adhesive is not a hot-applied joint compound; add an anchoring/chemical-fastener category.
Description explicitly identifies a non-shrink precision grout.
Three-part epoxy grouting system matches grout, not a joint sealant.
Polyester anchorage adhesive has no explicit adhesive or chemical-anchor leaf.
Explicit multipurpose epoxy grouting system.
Underwater microconcrete is not necessarily mortar; concrete-repair leaf granularity needs clarification.
Construction adhesive is distinct from sealant; no explicit construction-adhesive leaf.
PVC sheet membrane is not a liquid coating or joint profile; sheet-waterproofing leaf is missing.
Butyl adhesive jointing tape is not unambiguously a joint sealing profile; tape category is missing.
Self-smoothing polyurethane resin floor is a liquid-applied floor coating; not an epoxy floor.
Superplasticizer is added to fresh concrete, not a post-treatment curing agent; unspecified additive is the available leaf.
Water-reducing and retarding admixture for fresh concrete; not concrete post-treatment.
Concrete superplasticizer lacks a specific leaf; unspecified concrete additive fits the supplied taxonomy.
Nitrile-rubber contact adhesive for roof sheets is not itself a coating or sheet membrane.
Tile-fixing mortar is not necessarily concrete-repair mortar or floor filler; tile adhesive/mortar leaf is absent.
Protective epoxy-polysulfide coating overlaps coating material and paint/lacquer/coating leaves; clarify their boundary.
Water-reducing superplasticizing concrete admixture; not post-treatment.
Surface block sealer could fit sealant or saturant depending on taxonomy definitions; no unsupported forced leaf.
Cement-manufacturing grinding aid/air entrainer is not unambiguously a concrete additive; cement-additive leaf is missing.
Reinforced PVC roof sheet has no sheet-membrane leaf; it is not liquid coating.
PCE superplasticizer is mixed into fresh concrete, not applied after curing.
Ready-mix superplasticizer belongs to available unspecified concrete-additive leaf.
Explicit concrete/mortar superplasticizer; unspecified concrete additive is supported.
12 V cordless drywall screwdriver supports rechargeable quick-assembly screwdriver; no magazine stated.
Cordless sheet nibbler matches both 116902 and duplicate/misspelled 158413; taxonomy needs a canonical ID.
Cordless rotary hammer fits rechargeable rotary/demolition hammer.
Description explicitly says cordless angle grinder.
Heated clothing is not a power tool; no heated-apparel leaf.
Battery-powered jacket needs apparel category; do not force into tool parts.
Cordless inflator overlaps air-pump and compressed-air-pump leaves; required distinction is undocumented.
Mixer paddle is a mixing head accessory; listed tile adhesives/grout are materials it mixes, not the product.
Cordless multitool description does not explicitly establish the specific oscillator leaf; needs tool-motion evidence.
Description explicitly identifies a cordless hedge trimmer.
Laser tripod is a measuring accessory; no specific tripod/measurement-accessory leaf.
Polisher with 230 V model designation supports the electric polisher leaf.
Impact wrench is not automatically an impact screwdriver; pistol-grip nutrunner mapping requires a taxonomy convention.
Compact cordless circular saw fits rechargeable manual circular saw.
Same heated-jacket product appears under another URL; apparel remains out of taxonomy.
Description explicitly says cordless hot glue gun.
Only vacuum leaf requires both rechargeable and wet/dry; description does not establish wet/dry capability.
Cordless impact wrench needs an explicit impact-wrench/nutrunner mapping convention.
LED site spotlight with tripod is lighting, not a power tool; lighting leaf is absent.
Explicit cordless 12 V polisher fits rechargeable polisher, not sander.
Cordless safety vacuum description does not establish wet/dry capability required by available leaf.
Mixing paddle/head accessory, not the gypsum or coating materials mentioned as uses.
Leaf blower is not necessarily blower-vac; vacuum capability is not stated.
230 V variable-speed polisher fits electric polisher.
Cordless fan is not a hot-air gun; ventilation/fan leaf is absent.
Spiral mixing paddle is a mixing head, not paint or bitumen listed in applications.
Vacuum lifter is a suction lifting tool, not vacuum cleaner; lifting-tool leaf is absent.
Orbital sander and random-orbital disc sander are not interchangeable; exact available sander leaf needs clarification.
